mentions.note: famous Scottish walking champion; joined Belgrave in the Great War with the Scots Guards; first member to win the Murphy Shield (6 mile road walking championship); won the 7 mile Championship of Scotland in Scottish record; records for each mile 1 to 4 in a 4 mile handicap
won the inaugural R. Murphy Shield race over 6 miles; Scots Guardsman, later Scottish National champion

share.d: Colin McLellan in The Belgravian, the Belgrave Harriers club gazette, 1925–1967: 4 mentions in 4 issues and 1 race result.
